fields.label: Commission Type
fields.description: Item: billed to the shop on the items portion. Delivery: billed to the deliveryman on the delivery fee. Service: the order's service fee billed to the shop at credit delivery (the platform's share, taken up front so it carries no credit risk; on non-credit orders the service fee never enters the shop wallet and needs no row). Rows created before this field existed are Item commissions.

fields.label: Party
fields.description: The user whose wallet was billed: the shop owner for Item commissions, the deliveryman for Delivery commissions.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: The commission rate applied at settlement time, after override resolution (Item: nonzero Shop.percentage else the Commission Settings platform default; Delivery: the Deliveryman Profile override else the Commission Settings platform default else the legacy DeliveryMan Settings default).

fields.label: Base Amount
fields.description: The amount the commission was computed on: the order's items portion (total_price minus delivery_fee minus service_fee).

fields.label: Commission Amount
fields.description: The commission actually billed to the shop wallet at settlement (rate applied to base_amount). Deliberately differs from Order.commission_fee, which is computed on the full order total.

fields.label: Reversed Amount
fields.description: The portion of the commission credited back to the shop through refund clawbacks.
